column1: # The L1 WARNING dispositions (charter § 4 severity scope, mechanised by
# warnings-census.py; the spec review's MF-3). class<TAB>match-substring<TAB>disposition
# Every upstream WARNING class the oracle log carries is dispositioned here;
# an undispositioned class fails the census. Counts are informational (they
# move with seed edits); the CLASS SET is the pin (LAW 73's grain).
# RE-DISPOSITIONED for chaos-1.1.0 (v3.2 seat 10, D49): five classes born of
# the fresh families, each DELIBERATE - the shape the warning labels IS the
# probe; a sixth (the prefix annotation's naming contract on a function,
# 'must have prefix') fired at l1-s10-run2 on an authoring slip and was
# healed at the seed (C34Stage_Tag), so it is not a class here.

column2: The `as` keyword without a path is deprecated
column3: DELIBERATE: the 9.83.0-only rule `as` identifier syntax the § 7a axes name (S06/S07); the deprecation is upstream's own label for it

column2: Input type does not match qualification root type
column3: MEASURED UPSTREAM QUIRK: findRosettaQualifiableConfiguration takes getFirst over the index's roots per KIND, so with one root per variant the resolution is FIRST-WINS and order-dependent (an order that is a function of the resource PATH - v3.2 seat 4's three oracle order probes; a hash over resource URIs is consistent with it, inferred not measured) - at l1-run13 (chaos-1.0.0) the warning fired in ELEVEN of the 26 s22 files (20 occurrences, the variants whose own Product root LOST the first-wins race); at chaos-1.1.0 (D49) the s28 family adds the EVENT race with two qualifiers per variant and the A7 order-of-load axis (aaa-/zz- file names) - the losers' count is the pin CorpusDiagnosticGateTest carries per file, re-taken from the log at the swap. Every model here is in ONE project; whether a dependency's configuration can be a root is settled BY CODE (isProjectLocal admits every candidate under a non-platform URI - the post-9.83 source and the released 9.83.0 jar's bytecode alike, javap-verified at #625 round 2) and UNMEASURED only for the released plugin's runtime URI scheme (seat 4's banked item). ANSWERED at #625 (v3.2 seat 4): the fork reads the FIRST configuration per kind in load order from ONE declaration (RQualifiableConfig.firstRoot), warns the losers with upstream's message, and replays upstream's path-dependent winner by per-group pin
DELIBERATE: anonymous conditions are grammar-legal and seeded (S01 C1Cond); the warning is the expected upstream style nudge

column2: Using the path operator on a choice type is deprecated
column3: DELIBERATE (chaos-1.1.0, D49): the would-have-caught table's F15' leg (d) - an implicit-input attribute typed by a choice navigated by its BARE option at a rule seat (S28 `which -> C28OptA -> av`) and S25's choice-option only-exists receivers; the deprecation is upstream's label for the shape the seat-8 ladder census pinned 36 rows of

column2: Using only exist on a choice option is deprecated
column3: DELIBERATE (chaos-1.1.0, D49): the only-exists leaf over a choice OPTION (S25 `pick -> C25OptA only exists`) - the ladder-binding census's leaf class healed at seat 8 (36 rows over eight vendored cells carry it)

column2: Condition name should start with a capital
column3: DELIBERATE (chaos-1.1.0, D49): S27's lowercase condition names (`ists`, `der`, `ject`, `Result`, `List`) and S99's `eger` compose the condition CLASS names the seat-3 bankings target (Lists, C27Holder, Inject, ValidationResult, ArrayList; Integer in S99 alone - the java.lang shadow, one such probe per package) - the alias-conditions-header oracle group's own device

column3: DELIBERATE (chaos-1.1.0, D49): S32's attribute named `Class` - the getClass() collision with java.lang.Object, an upstream non-compiling-emission probe beside the `o` attribute
